opening.argument: The presenter links a $20 start to potential earnings of hundreds of thousands of dollars, then urges personal registrations and team recruitment as participants upgrade paid slots to continue earning. Viewers are instructed to transfer BNB and BUSD to activate those slots, and the slide shows an upgrade payment going to a superior partner with an eligible slot. The proposed earnings therefore rely on recruitment, paid position upgrades, and slot cycling, including the possibility of spillovers; the presenter acknowledges that spillovers are not guaranteed. Although the presenter denies that creators keep participants’ cryptocurrency, that denial does not change the recruitment- and upgrade-dependent structure presented to viewers.
